title: Key and click replies say what happened: the tool that took the input, the control it fired, the tool's result row or error, and its undo/redo heads
description:
After every key or click an agent calls ui-state and digs out ringTool.lastRow, error, nextUndo and activeTool to learn what the input did; the key reply itself only carries a global `consumed` counter delta (automation/endpoints/input/InjectKey.java:76-91) and the click reply (InjectClick.java) names no tool. The CRAW-58 segmentation run lost time on keys that silently did nothing (friction log F8, F14), and the 2026-10-21 audit confirmed it still holds.

After the input settles, the reply carries: the active tool (before and after, if the input switched tools), the ControlHint that fired (key plus description; record the last fired hint in the key dispatcher) or that nothing handled it, and the active tool's shared state from the Tool base (IX-5): its last result row, last error, and undo/redo heads.

Scope added 2026-10-24 (user): the tool-specific routes rings add, rings bisect, regions and connection are deleted. Agents drive tools only the way the UI does: the tools listing (each tool's controls), control to fire a row, key, click and hover at screen x,y (the tool converts to the surface itself, as for a mouse), and ui-state's tool block for results. No surface-point input is added, rings add has no replacement mode (RingTool.confirmPoints goes with it), the bisector's end ring labels and simple flag move into the ring tool's draft detail, and the regions route's extras (neighbours, colour, problems, ringsSplittingNothing, hidden ring labels, select query) are dropped, not exported elsewhere.
definition-of-done:
1. `ixdar-cli key` and `ixdar-cli click` replies include activeTool, the fired control (or a clear 'not handled'), the tool's last row and last error, and nextUndo/nextRedo, read from the Tool base, not per tool.
2. A key no tool handles says so.
3. Tests for a handled key, an unhandled key, a tool-switching key and a click; mvn test and test_cli pass.
4. rings add, rings bisect, regions and connection are deleted (Java routes, CLI commands, manifest entries, README lines, their tests) with RingTool.confirmPoints and ConnectionTool.connectPoints; the bisector draft's detail names its two end rings and whether it is simple.
5. Live on ring-tool through ixdar-cli only: a ring by hover + click + Enter, a bisector by K + two clicks + Enter with its end rings in the tool block, a connection by its switch key + two clicks.
testing-plan:
1. Before/after recordings of the affected routes in the scenes named.
2. mvn test; uv run python -m unittest ixdar_automation_cli.test_cli.
changes-made: InjectKey and InjectClick replies, after the input settles, carry activeTool, previousTool (when the input switched tools), control (the ControlHint fired: key, description, keyCode, controlHeld, shiftHeld, or null) and tool (State.toolSummary from the Tool base: name, lastRow, error, undo/redo depth and next names, mode/modes). The key reply also has handled and, when nothing or the focused terminal took the key, a reason naming the key and the active tool. KeyGuy records lastFiredControl through one fire(hint) used by key presses, held repeats and controls-menu row clicks (SceneModelMenu). New test ToolInputReplyTest (handled key, unhandled key, terminal-owned key, tool-switching key, click, tools listing, ring-scene descriptions). Verified on ring-tool (fertility_rings): P -> handled:false with reason; CTRL+R -> activeTool ring tool, previousTool orbit, control ctrl+R; T -> mode crease; click -> lastRow 'draft drafted...', nextUndo 'draft opened'; CTRL+T then SHIFT+H -> control shift+H hide selected regions (shiftHeld true). mvn test 610/0, test_cli 106/0. Before/after recordings in tmp/tool-36-before-routes.log and tmp/tool-36-after-routes.log.

Rework after review: the input-outcome capture lives once in InputSettle.settledInput, which InjectKey and InjectClick both call with their delivery as a callable (no holder arrays): on the render thread it clears KeyGuy.lastFiredControl, runs the delivery, writes control and the tool active before; after the settle frames it writes activeTool/previousTool and the Tool base summary. State.addInputOutcome is gone. handled now comes from the dispatcher (a fired control row, or the focused terminal taking the key via KeyGuy.terminalOwnsKey and Terminal.current), not the KeyActions.keysConsumed counter; consumed stays as the existing reply field. Live on ring-tool: P -> handled false with reason naming orbit; CTRL+R -> activeTool ring tool, previousTool orbit, control ctrl+R; T -> control 'mode: geodesic, switch to crease', tool.mode crease; click -> nextUndo 'draft opened'. mvn test 616/0, test_cli 106/0.

Tool's name/description accessors restored to master's per-tool overrides (see TOOL-38); the key/click outcome callers read toolName() again. mvn test 620/0, test_cli 112/0. The retirement of rings add/rings bisect/regions/connection (DoD 4) is not started, awaiting the user's decision on the reported gaps.

Retirement (user decision): deleted the rings add, rings bisect, regions and connection routes (Add/Bisect/Connection/Regions.java), their manifest entries (automation_routes.json regenerated, 50 routes), README sections and rows, and their CLI tests; the two rings-add grouping tests became one generic test of a spaced command name on a synthetic route, plus a test that no retired command remains. Deleted RingTool.confirmPoints (only rings add used it) and ConnectionTool.connectPoints (only connection used it). AuthoredPointsRingTest deleted: both its tests only exercised confirmPoints. The ring tool's draft detail now ends with 'bisector from <ring> to <ring>' for a bisector draft and 'simple' or 'crosses itself', replacing rings bisect's firstWall/lastWall/simple. The regions extras are dropped, not exported. Frame/SelectionBounds' --region help now points at the region tool's item labels. Bug found live and fixed: a click while a persistent hover is pinned left the pin in place, so the ring tool's next-frame pick ran at the hover point, not the click (the bisector's second end 'landed on the first', the connection's second pick 'already picked'); InjectClick now moves a pinned hover to the click point, regression test aClickMovesAPinnedHoverToTheClickSoTheNextFramePicksThere. Also fixed ToolInputReplyTest's stand-in platform to delegate to the suite platform, which had left shaders cached with null buffers for CreaseRingTest when run after it. Synced onto master a328b102 (UI-15; one DslGraphView conflict resolved keeping both). Live on ring-tool (fertility_rings), ixdar-cli only: ring = key CTRL+R, hover 240,480, click, click (anchor added: 2 authored + 9 supporting, 105 edges), key ENTER -> 'ring 13 ... unsaved', nextUndo 'draft confirmed'; bisector = key K, click 632,448, click 872,656 -> draft detail 'bisector from ring_17 to ring_05, simple', 28 edges, length 57.506; key ENTER -> 'bisector 14'; connection = key CTRL+J, click 800,560, click 480,560 -> 'not joined' (rings are walls), control --tool connection --key W -> path 111.85 over 83 faces, neck 73.11 around 33 edges, items path and neck. mvn test 626/0, test_cli 112/0.
review-summary:
InjectKey and InjectClick reply with the active tool, the ControlHint KeyGuy fired or why nothing took the key, and the tool's last row, error and undo heads; the tool-specific ring, region and connection routes are gone.
Agents drive every tool through the general input routes, as a user does.
